maintenance_led.reason: Aftermarket aircraft and engine sales of used parts, MRO, and PMA parts for airlines' existing fleets; sales of used assets also significant.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are commercial airlines, lessors and cargo operators paying privately for aircraft, engines, MRO and modifications.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling aircraft, engines, parts and MRO plus proprietary STC products like AerSafe; acquisitions are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Airlines can buy used aircraft, engines, parts and MRO from many suppliers; though certified STC products like AerSafe add some stickiness.

notes: Revenue split between asset sales/leasing and MRO/parts is not stated; maintenance_led and mission_critical are judgment calls.
